messages:
nina: Hi team, quick one 10 sessions of teletherapy with a specialist were billed out-of-network even though the provider appears in the insurer directory. Member paid $300 OOP. EOB says no prior auth required but claims were denied as out-of-network. Anyone seen this flow?
benefits-bot: Please submit a network-discrepancy ticket at https://benefits.redwood.example.com/network-discrepancy with: insurer directory screenshot, EOB PDF, provider NPI, and receipt. Mark as urgent if member already paid. Typical turnaround 5-7 business days.
leo-caseworker: Also DM me the member ID and date(s) of service so I can open a manual case and pull claim details. I can escalate to provider relations if insurer confirms directory error.
tara: Two quick checks: 1) confirm provider taxonomy (sometimes a clinician lists under a group that's not contracted), 2) ask provider to confirm the NPI/TIN they billed under. If they billed under a different NPI, insurer may treat it out-of-network.
provider-relations: If insurer accepts directory error, they should reprocess and issue an adjusted EOB. If denied, we can file an appeal citing incorrect network status; collect screenshots with timestamps and any provider confirmation.
nina: DM sent with member ID, EOB and screenshot. Provider says they billed under the solo NPI shown in directory.
leo-caseworker: Case created: ND-2026-198. Assigned to leo-caseworker. I'll contact insurer provider relations and request expedited re-adjudication. ETA 48-72 hours for acknowledgement.
benefits-bot: Reminder 1) Save receipts and call notes. 2) Member can submit for HSA/FSA reimbursement with EOB/receipt while issue is pending. 3) If insurer confirms denial after appeal, we can escalate to state DOI for persistent directory mismatch.
leo-caseworker: Update 1860001560 1 insurer acknowledged receipt and opened a re-adjudication. I'll post outcome when payment/adjustment posts.
